body_html:
How does the EPP collaborate with partners to provide expertise on new technology in  professional development for teachers in partner schools? For advanced-level specialists?
We host and organize a free 2 day professional seminar for building personal websites in NYC and New Haven: 

    • https://indieweb.org/2019/New_Haven
    • https://indieweb.org/2019/NYC
    • https://indieweb.org/2018/NYC


We run programs with community leaders in the non profit field working to address inequity in literacy:

  • https://medium.com/@Jhenryb92/equity-and-digital-literacies-abad645b4d45

We ran a Interdisciplinary Geographic Information Systems institute https://archive.jgregorymcverry.com/year-two-of-our-geography-information-systems-institute/
I and Regine served on the Mayor's Blue Ribbon Council for Reading and recommended greater digital literacy.https://www.nhregister.com/connecticut/article/New-Haven-Mayor-Harp-s-blue-ribbon-reading-11312890.php
The university also funded my start up ReVIEW Talent Feedback System which is used by districts all over CT for video based calibration training.https://blog.reviewtalentfeedback.com/2020/working-on-our-course-builder-plug-i-in-in-partnership-with

How do partners collaborate with the EPP to provide expertise on new technology to candidates in coursework, fieldwork, or clinical practice?
EDU106 we piloted a tool and helped develop software for Mozilla:
https://www.nhregister.com/news/article/SCSU-professor-looks-to-create-healthful-internet-12207165.php
We taught the GearUp kids EDU106 where our candidates worked as mentors
We taught GearUp kids through Elm City Webmakershttps://jgregorymcverry.com/notes/2020-05-11-3
Candidates are involved our efforts to build an OER network in Ghana
https://goifnetwork.org
https://jgregorymcverry.com/notes/2020-05-11-2

We have submitted over 3 million dollars in federal IES grant application to study the role of digital reading and writing.
https://jgregorymcverry.com/questiontheweb
Every student in EDU 307 online must design and teach a screeencast mini lesson, and then a module about a children's literacy genre:
http://edu307.jgregorymcverry.com/module6.html
